_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Tunisia covering Capsian culture, Phoenician Carthage, Punic Wars, Roman Africa (El Djem, Dougga), early Christianity (Tertullian, St Augustine nearby), Vandal and Byzantine rule, Arab conquest, Aghlabid and Hafsid dynasties, Ottoman regency, French protectorate 1881, Bourguiba modernisation, Ben Ali police state, 2010-2011 Jasmine Revolution (Arab Spring origin), and democratic transition challenges.

religion.note: Djerba synagogue (El Ghriba) is one of oldest in Africa; Jewish community ~1,000 remaining

ethnic_groups.name: Arab
ethnic_groups.notes: Arabic-speaking majority; heavily arabised Berber heritage; tribal identities less prominent than in Libya

ethnic_groups.name: Arabised Berber
ethnic_groups.notes: Historically Berber/Amazigh but culturally/linguistically arabised; many Tunisians of mixed ancestry; Berber identity reviving

ethnic_groups.name: Berber (Amazigh)
ethnic_groups.notes: Small communities in Djerba, Matmata, Douiret, Chenini; Shelha language speakers; troglodyte villages

ethnic_groups.name: Black Tunisian
ethnic_groups.notes: Sub-Saharan descent; legacy of trans-Saharan slave trade; southern regions; discrimination issues; 2018 anti-racism law

ethnic_groups.name: European/Other
ethnic_groups.notes: Small French, Italian, Maltese communities; most Europeans left after independence; Turkish descent from Ottoman era

current_leader.name: Kais Saied
current_leader.title: President
current_leader.notes: Independent/populist; constitutional law professor; suspended parliament July 2021; new constitution 2022 concentrating power in presidency; critics call it a coup; crackdown on opposition and migrants

former_leaders.name: Habib Bourguiba
former_leaders.notes: Father of independence; Supreme Combatant; modernised Tunisia: women's rights (Personal Status Code 1956), secularism, education; president-for-life; removed by Ben Ali in 'medical coup'

former_leaders.name: Zine El Abidine Ben Ali
former_leaders.notes: Police state; RCD party; economic growth but severe corruption; wife Leila Trabelsi/clan; fled to Saudi Arabia January 14, 2011 (Jasmine Revolution); died in exile 2019

former_leaders.name: Beji Caid Essebsi
former_leaders.notes: Nidaa Tounes; oldest elected head of state in Africa at 88; died in office July 2019; veteran Bourguibist

910.name: Prehistoric Tunisia
910.description: Capsian culture heartland; early North African pastoralism.

sub_clusters.name: Capsian Culture Heartland
sub_clusters.description: Eponymous site at Gafsa; Mesolithic industry; shell mound settlements.

920.name: Carthage — Phoenician Superpower
920.description: Phoenician colony becomes Mediterranean superpower; Punic Wars.

sub_clusters.name: Founding of Carthage
sub_clusters.description: Dido/Elissa founds Carthage; maritime trade empire; Tophet sanctuary.

sub_clusters.name: Punic Wars
sub_clusters.description: Three wars with Rome; Hannibal crosses Alps; Scipio destroys Carthage.

sub_clusters.name: Hannibal Barca
sub_clusters.description: Greatest military commander of antiquity; elephant crossing of Alps.

920.name: Roman and Byzantine Tunisia
920.description: Africa Proconsularis; El Djem amphitheatre; Vandal Kingdom; Byzantine reconquest.

sub_clusters.name: Roman Africa Proconsularis
sub_clusters.description: Granary of Rome; Dougga, El Djem; Tertullian and early Christianity.

sub_clusters.name: Vandal and Byzantine Periods
sub_clusters.description: Genseric's Vandal Kingdom; Belisarius reconquest; decline.

sub_clusters.name: Kairouan — Fourth Holiest City
sub_clusters.description: Uqba ibn Nafi founds Kairouan; Great Mosque; Islamic learning centre.

sub_clusters.name: Aghlabid Dynasty
sub_clusters.description: Autonomous governors; Sicily conquest; ribat architecture.

sub_clusters.name: Hafsid Dynasty
sub_clusters.description: Tunis capital; Alhambra refugees; al-Zaytouna University; Ottoman takeover.

930.name: Ottoman Tunisia (Beylik of Tunis)
930.description: Husainid dynasty; corsairs; Tunisian Fundamental Pact; French ambitions.

sub_clusters.name: Husainid Dynasty
sub_clusters.description: Semi-autonomous beys; Ahmad Bey modernisation; first constitution in Muslim world 1861.

sub_clusters.name: Tunisian Reform Movement
sub_clusters.description: Abolition of slavery 1846 (first in Muslim world); Fundamental Pact 1857.

940.name: French Protectorate
940.description: French colonial rule; Destour and Neo-Destour parties; Bourguiba's rise.

sub_clusters.name: Treaty of Bardo
sub_clusters.description: France imposes protectorate; settler colonialism begins.

sub_clusters.name: Neo-Destour and Bourguiba
sub_clusters.description: Habib Bourguiba founds Neo-Destour; modern nationalist movement; prison and exile.

sub_clusters.name: WWII — Tunisia Campaign
sub_clusters.description: Kasserine Pass; Axis defeat in North Africa; Allied springboard to Sicily.

950.name: Independence and Bourguiba Era
950.description: Independence; radical modernisation; women's rights; single-party state.

sub_clusters.name: Tunisia Independence (1956)
sub_clusters.description: Independence 20 March 1956; Bourguiba first PM, then president.

sub_clusters.name: Bourguiba's Modernisation
sub_clusters.description: Personal Status Code; women's rights; secular education; Francophone elite.

sub_clusters.name: Ben Ali Deposes Bourguiba
sub_clusters.description: 'Medical coup'; Ben Ali takes power; initial liberalisation hopes.

960.name: Ben Ali Era
960.description: Police state; economic growth; corruption; repression.

sub_clusters.name: Ben Ali Dictatorship
sub_clusters.description: Economic liberalisation; tourism; systematic repression; Trabelsi clan corruption.

960.name: Tunisian Revolution and Democratic Experiment
960.description: Jasmine Revolution sparks Arab Spring; democratic transition; Saied regression.

sub_clusters.name: Jasmine Revolution
sub_clusters.description: Bouazizi self-immolation; mass protests; Ben Ali flees; sparks Arab Spring.

sub_clusters.name: Democratic Transition
sub_clusters.description: National Dialogue Quartet (Nobel Peace Prize 2015); new constitution; fragile democracy.

sub_clusters.name: Saied's Authoritarian Turn
sub_clusters.description: President Saied suspends parliament; new constitution; democratic backsliding.
